Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Industrial Hood Pendant Light Chandelier - 8 Inch Shade, 13 - 61 Inch Cord, Brushed Nickel
Colors: Brushed Nickel
Materials: Metal
This simple pendant light is ideally suited to add sleek elegance to a kitchen island or bar area. The classic dome-shaped hood includes a frosted glass shade to soften the light. Rods are included for a wide range of height adjustments. 8" Diameter. Rods adjust height from 13"-61". Brushed nickel rod and hood; glass shade Will blend with traditional and modern styles. Ideal for bar area or kitchen island. Bulbs not included Professional installation recommended. Intended for indoor use only
